<style>
  padding: 16px;
  border: 1px solid var(--line);

  &:hover {
    border-color: #c8102e;
  }

  article {
    display: grid;
    gap: 8px;

    h2 {
      margin: 0;
    }
  }

  @keyframes enter {
    from { opacity: 0; }
    to { opacity: 1; }
  }
</style>

<style global>
  :root {
    --line: #e6e7ea;
  }
</style>

<article><slot /></article>
